details.description: The production API currently carries the Office/diagnostic Agent overlays recorded before this candidate.

change_summary.expected_result: A semantically empty Agent model response is shown as an actionable regenerate/choose-another-model error, is persisted as a terminal assistant failure, and does not leave the conversation parent in saving state. User-initiated Stop remains distinct from system generation failure.
functions: Classify semantic empty responses as EMPTY_MODEL_RESPONSE with a bounded responseShape.
Persist a terminal assistant error and emit final after a generation failure.
Use only the job AbortController signal for user Stop classification.
Store only allowlisted bounded response-shape metadata in diagnostic events.
Replace four read-only API mounts and recreate only LibreChat-API.
limitations: The candidate does not rebuild the full frontend bundle; BaseClient.js is mounted as a versioned API runtime overlay.
Acceptance uses at most one non-destructive vip998 Agent request and does not create or mutate business data.
This release does not prove every upstream provider response shape or load behavior.
change_summary.reason: Production logs show repeated system-side generation_failed events after 135-227 seconds with an SSE 200 response and a semantically empty model payload. The failure path did not finalize the preliminary parent, so follow-up requests could receive HTTP 409 parent-saving errors.
change_summary.risk: The API runtime and user-visible error lifecycle change could affect Agent streaming, retry, and Stop behavior. The release is limited to four read-only API mounts, requires baseline hashes and protected-container identity checks, and has automatic Compose rollback.

details.method: The versioned runner saves compose.override.yaml and the preflight/container baseline before the write; remote-rollback.py restores that exact Compose file and recreates only LibreChat-API.
details.unchanged_data: No MongoDB data, CodeAPI processes, NGINX, RAG, Admin Panel, Office service, users, files, or conversations are modified by the runner.

validation_plan.expected: Focused empty-response lifecycle and privacy-boundary tests pass.
Runner, target lock, protected-service, rollback, and Python/Bash syntax contracts pass.
Fresh read-only container, Compose, resource, dependency, and four-target baseline checks pass.
Only LibreChat-API is recreated; four target hashes and protected service IDs verify.

validation_plan.command: Use vip998 for one non-destructive Agent request, inspect the changed failure/retry path and user Stop path, then run scripts/release-acceptance.sh with evidence.
validation_plan.expected: Actionable empty-response error is visible, regeneration is no longer blocked by a saving parent, and protected public health checks remain passing.
